content: Bepaŋdi nemek tuguk eŋ tilak wendiniŋ niutumba kap
Kwetfoloŋ metam hogohogok, hidi Bepaŋ nintilooŋ kakaliŋa nadifo tineŋ.
Wougigitŋiŋ nintiloune foloniŋgoŋ hinek gwaŋ looŋ halek, kaŋ kap toŋa wougigitŋiŋ yotubuhautaneŋ.
Indi Bepaŋ indiŋ ninim, “Du nemenemek tilaŋ hogohogok woŋ adi uŋgoniŋ hinehinek. Eŋ saŋiniŋge adi loloŋnit hinek, doktiŋa memikgeye adi dutok munta kisaŋ hinek tiŋa namandake foloŋ mulelem tigamiiŋ.
“Kwetfoloŋ memetam hogohogok adi du ganiutumbaiŋ. Tiŋa kap tonadifo tigamuŋa kakaliŋa wohogigit yotilooŋ kap toiŋ.”
Hidi buŋa Bepaŋdi nemek tuguk i kaneŋ. Adi metam’walaŋ lekiŋgoŋhik foloŋ nemenemek uŋgoniŋ hinek tuguk.
Adi imeŋgwaŋ u yobune kwet siliŋ mintaguk, kaŋ mamahi-papahiye adi kwet wendok foloŋ yalitauyeŋ ime wapum u meŋeŋa fokolok logiŋ. Unduŋ doktiŋa aditok welenadifo nadiminim.

Adi saŋiniŋŋiŋ wapum hinek, eŋ mapme dapmandapmaŋnit mokit hatilak. Tiŋa undugoŋ, metamdi maŋgoŋ kabekabe tiiŋ hogohogok u wanakaŋ hinek yabunadidapmalak. Unduneŋ ala, tiyaugene nebek niŋdi Bepaŋ nimpekit be niŋkadaka mu taneeŋ.
Metambop wanakaŋ hogohogok hidi Bepaŋnik niutumbaneŋ, kaŋ youtumbahik diniŋ gigilitŋiŋdi mintaune nadineŋ.
Adigoŋ nibudokoune kaipmuŋ hatiyam, eŋ nihitubu-lodalak kaŋ mu kadakayam.
O Bepaŋ, du silwa kudup gineŋ heune dagweheyeeŋ datilitiliyelak kaŋ geŋgeŋŋiŋ makwaneune silwa hogokdi walandaaŋ fafau hinek mintalak, wendok tuwot hinek indi nihimahamuka mahamuka tuguŋ.
Du begepge gineŋ nihoneeŋ malabumuŋ wapum foloonik foloŋ kameguŋ.
Du binibune memik hekidi nihiyali-befohinaka tigiŋ. Kaŋ indi kudup eŋ imegabuŋ gineŋ hatigumun, iŋgoŋ fiit kotigoŋ ninigila labuŋa yokwet fofooŋ gineŋ nipmeguŋ.
Nu dumuŋ kunilit dadapmaŋ titiŋdok beŋa du yokeneŋ wooŋ siloŋ tigambit, siloŋ u titiŋdok agaŋ koom yofafaŋegut uŋakoŋ tigambit.
Koom malabumuŋ maaneŋ hatiŋila nemek niŋ gamdok yogut uŋakoŋ gambit.
Nu kale galikihinit kawade-bubu foloŋ heeŋ siloŋ tigambit. Eŋ dompa maahi hegambit, kaŋ siloŋ wendiniŋ munduŋ momooŋ nadiweŋ. Eŋ makau maaniŋ tiŋa meme u beŋa siloŋ tigambit.
Metam hogohogok Bepaŋ’walaŋ hebeŋ foloŋ hatiiŋ, hidi buŋa nu’walaŋ mede nadineŋ. Kaŋ nu Bepaŋdi nemenemek hogohogok tiŋa nehitubu-lodaguk wendok hanimbit.
Nu koom nehitubu-lodawek yoŋa gibitaŋ kutiniŋgut. Unduŋ doktiŋa nu kap toŋa wou nintiloloŋdok tiulidoko tugut.
Iŋgoŋ welenedi titiŋ hogohi wendok nadigalikaaŋ yabukahileeŋ boihatibit adi Wapumdi ninadine tuwot mu nadinambek.
Iŋgoŋ Bepaŋ adi agaŋ magi kametnadi tuguk. Biyagoŋ hinek, yonadine agaŋ nadinamguk.
Nu Bepaŋ niutumbalat. Adi yonadine nadiŋa sigilulum mu tinamulak. Tiŋa undugoŋ, nutok siloŋ tobogoŋ tinamulak u mu kameheguk.
